title: Setup & Brand Identity
description: The journey begins here. I'll help you acquire the perfect domain name, set up secure professional business emails (e.g., mail@yourcompany.com), and gather all essential requirements to define a solid technical strategy for your brand

title: UI/UX Design & Collaborative Approval
description: Transforming ideas into visual layouts using Figma. I create customized UI/UX wireframes and mockups. We refine the design collaboratively, and the development starts only after you are 100% satisfied and give the green light.

title: Core Frontend Engineering & Development
description: Breathing life into approved designs. I write clean, highly optimized, and fully responsive code to ensure smooth animations, lightning-fast loading speeds, and a stellar user experience.

title: Secure Deployment & Launch
description: Taking your business live to the world. I configure custom domains, deploy your website on high-performance lightning-fast servers, ensure top-tier security with SSL certificates, and hand over a fully functional, production-ready digital platform.
